name: Popconfirm
summary: A lightweight inline confirmation popover anchored to the trigger — confirm/cancel a low-risk action.
highlights: Confirm or cancel a low-risk action
lead: Popconfirm carries a positioned popover, a focus trap and two action buttons — too much to rebuild as a web component, so it stays on real Ant: antd v6 (React) and ant-design-vue v4 (Vue), both themed once by the shared popconfirmTheme. Two implementations, one DS V3 look. This is the composite half of the hybrid.

spec.label: Buttons
spec.value: DS small button size: 28px tall · 4px corners · 14px semibold · 8px inline padding

spec.label: Destructive confirm
spec.value: destructiveConfirm: Cancel is the primary (#E70E68, white label) · Delete / Remove is the danger button (black #000000 fill, white label)

spec.label: Plain confirm
spec.value: primary confirm #E70E68 · white label, beside a default Cancel (1px #E3E3E3 border · #1A1A1A label)

spec.label: Icon
spec.value: <aha-icon name="system-warning-circle" size="16"> in black, the same glyph the Modal confirmation uses; never a coloured status icon

spec.label: Anchor
spec.value: pops from the trigger; not a full modal

spec.label: Placement
spec.value: top · bottom · left · right (arrow tracks the trigger)

spec.label: Trigger
spec.value: a DS <aha-button>, never an antd Button

props.name: onConfirm
props.desc: Fires when the confirm button is clicked

props.name: placement
props.desc: Where the popover opens relative to the trigger

props.name: ...destructiveConfirm
props.desc: Spread on a destructive confirm (Delete, Remove): Cancel becomes the primary button and the confirm the black danger button. Leave it off for a plain confirm

props.name: icon
props.desc: Pass <aha-icon name="system-warning-circle" size="16"> so the popover header carries the DS glyph in black

whenToUse.when: a low-risk, reversible action needs a quick inline check (delete a row, discard a draft)
a destructive or irreversible action needs a deliberate, focused confirmation
the action is trivial and easily undone — prefer an undo toast

opinion.note: Reserve Popconfirm for low-risk, reversible actions — anchor it to the trigger and keep the question to one line. A destructive or irreversible action (delete account, publish) needs a Modal (see the overlays pattern), never a popover.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — antd v6 Popconfirm themed by the shared popconfirmTheme; matrix: Placement (top · bottom · left · right) × Destructive (on → Cancel primary #E70E68 + black danger confirm #000000 via destructiveConfirm / off → primary confirm #E70E68 + #E3E3E3-border Cancel), over a radius-8 white popover with 28px DS-small action buttons. Verified via Figma search_design_system on the DS V3 file (MwjvUjVI0HnfwD9EwPXRAy): DS V3 ships no measured Popconfirm cell (nearest is the 'Delete confirmation' Dialog), so this is a deliberate, documented token mapping onto antd's Popconfirm rather than a re-implementation.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: Composite has no framework-free element, so its paste-and-run form is a CDN-React page — React + antd load from a CDN and mount on open, consuming the SAME shared popconfirmTheme. No build step.

codeNote: React and Vue are two real vendor libraries at two Ant generations — they can't share a primitive. They converge via the same token/theme (popconfirmTheme); residual drift is caught by visual regression.

action buttons at the DS small size (28px · radius 4 · 14px semibold)
header icon is the black DS glyph (aha-icon system-warning-circle)

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Composite shown as a CDN-React page mounted at #react-root; the Popconfirm is open in its default demo state (a destructive confirm), its popover portalled to <body>, so the real antd v6 popover surface and both action buttons bound to popconfirmTheme + destructiveConfirm are measurable at document level. Selectors match antd v6: the surface is .ant-popover-container; the buttons are scoped to .ant-popconfirm-buttons, where the danger confirm carries .ant-btn-dangerous and the primary Cancel does not.
